title: A released swipe re-resolves its action when it fires, so a chat state change in the 150 ms spring-back flips the action
trigger: Swipe a row past the threshold with Mute configured while the chat is unmuted, release; another device (or a sync) mutes the chat within 150 ms.
effect: poll() returns only the chat id; chat_swipe_ui.rs:290 perform_swipe_action recomputes the label from current facts, so the action run is Unmute while the panel showed Mute. Tiny window.
fix: Store the resolved SwipeLabel in Release and fire exactly that action.

title: set_search_filters with an empty query changes the tab but keeps the generation and results, so an in-flight answer of the old tab still applies
trigger: Open search on Chats (recents request in flight), switch to Channels or Posts with an empty field.
effect: The Recent chats list lands under the new tab and the panel reads Ready.
fix: Bump the generation and clear results whenever filters change.

title: select_search_chat_open closes search without clearing the typing debounce, so a pending commit fires into a closed search
trigger: Type a query and pick a recent chat or hit inside the debounce window.
effect: commit_debounced_search later sends searchChats/searchMessages/searchPublicChats for a closed search; wasted requests and results into hidden state.
fix: Make Session::close_search (or a ConnectDriver wrapper) always clear the debounce.

title: jump_shared_media_to_day takes history_calendar and then returns Ok without doing anything if the chat changed or the day has no media
trigger: Pick a day in the shared-media calendar after switching the gallery's chat, or a day with no nearby media.
effect: The calendar box is consumed and closes as if the jump happened; nothing loads.
fix: Return an outcome (Jumped/NoMedia/Stale) so the caller can show a note, and take the calendar only after the checks.

title: Folder share error is not matched to the folder or request that failed
trigger: Share Folder dialog open for folder A while a link request for folder B (or a recommended-folders fetch) fails
effect: The error text shows in A's dialog; the dialog for the failed request sees nothing
fix: Carry the folder id (or request id) in the error and show it only to the dialog for that folder.

title: chat_action_error is one slot overwritten by the next failure
trigger: Two chat-list actions (pin, mark unread) fail before the UI drains the note
effect: Only the last error is shown; the first is lost
fix: Queue of notes instead of Option<String>.

title: Public-post search limits are applied without tying them to the query or search generation
trigger: Type query A, then B in Public posts; limits for A answer last
effect: tabs.limits (including current_query_free and star_count) comes from any GetPublicPostSearchLimits answer (lines 100-108) while every message answer is matched by generation; the paid-search gate search_public_posts_paid (connect/search/tabs.rs:140) reads the price from it and the UI shows free/paid for the wrong query
fix: Carry the generation in the limits request and drop answers of an older generation.

title: 'Hide new chats?' box reopens after Cancel/Esc when hideSuggestedAction cannot be sent
trigger: The suggestion box is up while the client is not on the chats path (auth not Ready or shutdown started, e.g. during a log-out/close); press Cancel or Esc
effect: hide_suggested_action returns Err before removing the action locally, so archive_mute_suggested() stays true: the shell reopens the box and every close adds another 'could not hide' error toast
fix: Remove the action locally (or record a per-account 'dismissed' value) regardless of the send result, so the box's open state does not depend on the request succeeding.

title: Cached drag classification is reused for the next drag with the same paths
trigger: Drag a file over the list, cancel, change what the path holds (empty the folder, delete the file), drag the same path again.
effect: same_paths() sees equal paths so fresh is None and the old DragState is kept; the row lights up (or refuses) by the old probe and drop_on_row attaches by the old kind (Folder vs Files).
fix: Clear paths/drag when the drag ends or leaves (drag_left/over=false/drop) so each drag probes again.

title: A file drag's one-second 'open the chat' timer can fire for a later forward drag
trigger: Drag files over row A (timer armed), cancel the drag without an exit event reaching the list (Esc), and start a forward drag from a history that rests on row A within one second.
effect: choose_row_by_drag checks only hover == chat and cx.has_active_drag() (true for the forward drag), so the chat opens although forward drags never open by resting (_dragForward); forward_over_row does not cancel `rest`.
fix: Fold into the ListDrag enum so entering the Forward variant drops the Files variant and its timer.

title: chat_list.items is a render-time cache read by key stepping while another pane is drawn
trigger: Open the Contacts or Calls tab or the search results (sidebar_chats not run), then press Alt+Down / Ctrl+Tab, or drag files over a row.
effect: step_open_chat, rows_selecting and freeze_list read chat_list.items from the last chats render, so stepping uses a list that is not on screen.
fix: Derive the stepping list from the same listing function the render uses (or clear items when the chats pane is not drawn).

title: RowFxMap (online-dot and badge animation state) is app-wide, keyed by bare chat id, never reset on an account switch and never pruned
trigger: Account A shows a private chat (id = peer's user id) online with a badge; switch to account B whose chat with the same peer has a different online/badge state
effect: The row animates the dot/badge from A's state (a spurious grow-in/shrink and animation ticks) instead of snapping on first sight; the map also grows with every chat ever drawn
fix: Move row_fx into ChatListUi (OnScreen, replaced on a switch) or key it by AccountChat.

title: A due swipe action runs after the passcode lock
trigger: Swipe a chat row past the threshold, lift the finger, lock Quill (shortcut or idle timer) within the 20 ms poll.
effect: poll_swipe calls perform_swipe_action without refused_while_locked: a mute/pin/archive is applied under the lock and Delete opens its confirm box (hidden until unlock).
fix: Drop the gesture in the lock's close_for_lock and check refused_while_locked in poll_swipe.

title: Contacts Retry that fails to send leaves 'Loading contacts...' with nothing in flight
trigger: Contacts tab shows 'Couldn't load contacts'; the connection bridge is dead or the send fails; press Retry
effect: fetch_contacts clears contacts_error before send_json; on a send error it returns Err without setting it again, retry_contacts only toasts, so the list (contacts None, error false) reads as loading and nothing is in flight until a later contact change calls refetch_open_contacts (set_contact_sync has the same path)
fix: Make the contacts list a Fetch<Vec<..>> (idle/loading/ready/failed) set to failed by the send error in one place.

title: Sync contacts switch stays flipped when saving contacts_prefs.json fails
trigger: Settings > Contacts > toggle Sync contacts while the data folder is not writable.
effect: An error toast shows, but the in-memory pref (and the switch) stays at the new value. After a restart it is back to the old value.
fix: Save first and apply the new value only on success, or roll the in-memory value back on error.

title: Copied check mark on a folder invite link never reverts
trigger: Share Folder, copy a link. The copy button keeps the copied icon until the dialog closes or another link is copied.
effect: Stale 'copied' state; no clock reverts it.
fix: Store copied as Option<(link, Instant)> reverted by a spawn_screen timer, or an enum Copy { Idle, Copied(link) } cleared by a manual clock.

title: Folder invite dialog seeds its ticks from session invite info that is not matched to its link
trigger: Open an addlist link, then open a second addlist link while check_folder_invite_link of the second fails to send (the first link's folder_invite_info is still in the session).
effect: drive_folder_invite (folder_share/mod.rs:841-858) takes folder_invite_info without comparing it to dialog.link, so the new dialog seeds and lists the first link's chats and Add would join them.
fix: Key folder_invite_info by link (or hold it in the dialog as Checking(link) / Checked(info) / Adding / Failed) so an answer is applied only to its own link.

title: Share Folder busy/error are applied from session one-shots not matched to the folder or request
trigger: Share Folder for folder A > Create link > Save (busy); close the box; open Share Folder for folder B and start editing a link; A's answer lands.
effect: drain_folder_share applies folder_link_saved / folder_share_error to whatever share box is open: B is switched to the List view (losing its form) or shows A's error, and B's busy is cleared while B's own request is still out.
fix: `enum ShareStage { List, Editing{link}, Saving{request, link}, Failed }` in the dialog, and the session answer carries (folder_id, RequestId) compared before applying.

title: Shared-folder join dialog keeps stale selected ids and can join chats no longer offered
trigger: Open the 'N new chats' dialog, then the list changes (chat joined elsewhere, bar dismissed by poll) while it is open
effect: Dialog shows an empty list yet 'Join N' stays enabled from the stale set and sends removed ids to processChatFolderNewChats
fix: Intersect selected with folder_new_chats at confirm and render (or close the dialog when the offer is gone).

title: Join box for a shared folder's new chats keeps ticks for chats no longer offered
trigger: Open the 'N new chats' join box; while it is open the poll refreshes folder_new_chats and the owner removed a chat; click Join.
effect: selected was seeded at open and is never pruned against the current list; confirm sends ids that are no longer offered, so the request can fail with an error toast after the box closed.
fix: Send selected ∩ the current folder_new_chats list (or rebuild the selection when the list changes).

title: A folder limit hit is not matched to the request that hit it: it clears busy/adding on whichever box is open and guesses the window
trigger: With a Share Folder link save in flight, create a folder from Settings that hits the folder limit (or vice versa).
effect: drain_folder_limit takes the session-wide folder_limit_hit and clears FolderShareDialog::busy and FolderInviteDialog::adding unconditionally, re-enabling Save/Add while their own requests are still in flight; the limit box goes to the window of whichever of invite/share/editor is open, not the one whose request failed.
fix: Carry the asking request id (or FolderOp + dialog) in folder_limit_hit and leave only that dialog's in-flight stage.

title: Add-folder box: seeded + adding bools plus session info/error/done one-shots kept in step by hand
trigger: Click Add in the add-folder box; the add's answer is lost (request dropped on a reconnect) or an error lands and the user retries.
effect: adding is cleared only when folder_invite_error is Some (or a limit hit); a dropped answer leaves the button spinning and disabled until the box is closed. Stages live across FolderInviteDialog::{seeded,adding} and ChatListState::{folder_invite_info,folder_invite_error,folder_invite_done}.
fix: One FolderInviteStage enum on the dialog (see the checking finding); every stage, Adding included, is left by the matching answer, error or close.

title: Delete-folder box has no loading stage for the chats-to-leave list
trigger: Delete a shared folder and click Delete before getChatFolderChatsToLeave answers.
effect: The box shows the plain 'Delete' text as if there were nothing to leave; confirm_folder_delete reads whatever is in the session at click time, so an early click deletes the folder without offering to leave its chats.
fix: Give FolderDeleteConfirm a Fetch<Vec<i64>> for the suggestions (shared folders only) and disable the confirm while Loading.

title: Deleting a folder that fails still moves the chat list off that folder tab
trigger: Delete the folder you are viewing while deleteChatFolder cannot be sent.
effect: confirm_folder_delete takes delete_confirm, and resets folders.tab to All even in the Err arm; the folder still exists, an error note is shown.
fix: Reset the tab only when the delete is confirmed by updateChatFolders.
